You are building the BLOG / CONTENT-MARKETING system (blog, guides, comparison pages, status page, admin blog editor) for the Nxeon VPS hosting platform at /opt/nxeon. Three OTHER agents are concurrently editing OTHER areas of this repo, so ONLY touch YOUR OWNED FILES.

## CODEBASE PRIMER
- Next.js 15 App Router + React 19 + Tailwind v4 + Prisma. Server Actions in `lib/actions-*.ts` marked `"use server"` (only async exports). Plain helpers/constants go in a normal `.ts` module.
- Prisma: `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`. Client is ALREADY generated with a NEW model:
  - `BlogPost { id, slug(unique), title, excerpt, body(markdown), coverEmoji:String?, tags:String[], author(default "Nxeon"), category(default "Guides"), published:Bool, publishedAt:DateTime?, seoTitle:String?, seoDescription:String?, createdAt, updatedAt }`
- SEO helpers already exist: `import { FaqJsonLd, ArticleJsonLd } from "@/components/marketing/StructuredData"` — use them. Per-page metadata via `export const metadata` or `export async function generateMetadata()` returning a Next `Metadata` (set title, description, `alternates.canonical`, `openGraph`). `APP_URL = process.env.APP_URL ?? "https://revsports.ca"`.
- Auth for admin pages: `import { requireArea } from "@/lib/rbac"` then `await requireArea("platform")`.
- Design system (globals.css classes): `.card`, `.btn-primary`, `.btn-secondary`, `.btn-ghost`, `.input`, `.table-shell`. Dark premium theme, slate text, brand accent (`text-brand-300`, `from-brand-400 to-brand-300` for gradient text). Primitives: `import { PageHeader, Badge, timeAgo } from "@/components/ui/primitives"`.
- READ FIRST to match style: `app/(marketing)/layout.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/features/page.tsx`, `components/marketing/sections.tsx` (has `SectionHeading`, `CtaBand`), `components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx`, `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx`, and `app/admin/plans/page.tsx` for the admin CRUD pattern.
- Markdown: there is NO markdown library installed and you must NOT add one. Render post `body` with a SMALL self-contained markdown-to-HTML helper you write in `lib/blog.ts` (handle #/##/### headings, **bold**, `code`, - lists, links, paragraphs, blank-line paragraphs). Escape HTML first. (A similar renderer exists at `scripts/publish-docs.mjs` you may reference for approach — do NOT edit it.)

## WHAT TO BUILD
1. **Blog index** `/blog` — lists published posts (cards with coverEmoji, title, excerpt, category, date), newest first, SEO metadata, nice hero.
2. **Blog post** `/blog/[slug]` — renders a published post from markdown; `generateMetadata` for per-post SEO (title/description/canonical/openGraph); include `ArticleJsonLd`. 404 (via `notFound()`) if missing/unpublished.
3. **Comparison pages** (high-intent SEO): `/vps-vs-digitalocean` and `/vps-vs-hostinger` under the (marketing) group — honest, tasteful comparison tables + FAQ using `FaqJsonLd`. Keep claims truthful (Nxeon = single Singapore node, NVMe, game servers, dedicated-IP option, domains). Also a small `/compare` hub linking both.
4. **Status page** `/status` — a clean uptime/status page. Since there's no real monitoring backend, show the current operational components (Web, Provisioning, Network, Backups) as "Operational" with a note that it's a live-status placeholder; make it look production-grade. Keep it a server component.
5. **Admin blog editor** `/admin/blog` — `requireArea("platform")`; list posts in `.table-shell`, create/edit (title, slug, excerpt, body markdown, coverEmoji, tags, category, published toggle, seoTitle/seoDescription), delete. Use `components/admin/BlogControls.tsx` (client) wired to server actions in `lib/actions-blog.ts`.
6. **Seed content**: `prisma/seed-blog.ts` — insert ~4 genuinely useful starter posts (e.g. "How to set up a Minecraft server on a VPS", "VPS vs shared hosting: which do you need?", "Securing your first Linux VPS: 10 steps", "How to point a domain at your Nxeon server"), each ~400-700 words of real markdown, published=true, sensible slug/excerpt/tags/seo fields. Then RUN it: `cd /opt/nxeon && npx tsx prisma/seed-blog.ts` (this only writes content rows — allowed).
7. Add nav links to Blog / Compare / Status in `components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx` and `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx` (you own these two files).

## YOUR OWNED FILES (create/edit ONLY these)
- CREATE: `lib/blog.ts` (fetch helpers + markdown renderer), `lib/actions-blog.ts` (`"use server"`: admin create/update/delete/togglePublish), `app/blog/page.tsx`, `app/blog/[slug]/page.tsx`, `app/status/page.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/vps-vs-digitalocean/page.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/vps-vs-hostinger/page.tsx`, `app/(marketing)/compare/page.tsx`, `app/admin/blog/page.tsx`, `components/admin/BlogControls.tsx`, `prisma/seed-blog.ts`.
- EDIT (sole owner): `components/marketing/MarketingHeader.tsx`, `components/marketing/MarketingFooter.tsx`.

## HARD RULES
- NEVER touch: prisma/schema.prisma, next.config.ts, app/layout.tsx, app/globals.css, components/portal/Shell.tsx, lib/auth.ts, lib/db.ts, scripts/publish-docs.mjs, ROADMAP.md, docs/**, or any file not in your owned list.
- Do NOT run `npm run build`, `next build`, `prisma db push/migrate/generate`, or restart services. You MAY run `npx tsx prisma/seed-blog.ts` to seed content. Do NOT git commit/push. No new npm deps.
- `"use server"` files export only async functions.

## FINAL REPORT
Return: files created/edited (one line each), confirmation the seed ran and how many posts exist, any INTEGRATION NEEDED, and anything incomplete.

## What you'll need

- A VPS with at least **2 GB of RAM** (4 GB is comfortable for a handful of friends and plugins)
- Ubuntu 24.04 or Debian — this guide uses Ubuntu

## Step 1: Update the system

First, connect over SSH and get the box up to date:

\`\`\`

## What shared hosting is

On shared hosting, hundreds of websites live on one server and split its resources. You get a control panel, someone else manages the operating system, and it's cheap. The trade-off is that you're sharing CPU, memory and disk with everyone else on the box — and a busy neighbour can slow you down.
